title: Cardinality of a support fiber
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet, fix a word $u \colon \{1,\dots,n\} \to \alpha$ of length $n$, and let $S \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}$ be a set of coordinate positions. Then the number of words $v$ of length $n$ over $\alpha$ that differ from $u$ at exactly the positions in $S$ (that is, $v_i \ne u_i$ for $i \in S$ and $v_i = u_i$ for $i \notin S$) is
\[
  (\abs{\alpha} - 1)^{\abs{S}}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: a set $S$ of coordinate positions among $\{1,\dots,n\}$
